reviews.title: I love it
reviews.text: I’d struggled with my weight for years. I tried everything and spent a lot of money, but saw no real results. Then I decided to try intermittent fasting. I began losing about 0.5 lbs per day. I followed the app’s dietary guidelines closely, with small tweaks to fit my African dietary preferences. I cut out sugar and unhealthy snacks. In three weeks, I went from 147 lbs to 136 lbs. I also exercise daily. My BMI moved from slightly overweight to normal. I feel great and would definitely recommend this.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE if you don’t want to be ripped off and waste your time
reviews.text: I jumped on during a promotion and things were okay, but honestly I wasn’t able to use the app as I wanted due to a family member’s illness and being the caretaker. My account was deactivated due to inactivity. I have been going for over 1 month trying to get everything cancelled. They charge me twice a month $39.99. No number to call and everything in the email has been an automated response. Because of the deactivation, I can’t log in to get cancelled fully. But, no person has helped me to get cancelled by email, so they continue to charge me for a service I am not using and physically can’t use due to the account being deactivated. I don’t know how you can continue to charge an account that has deactivated, that is just poor service from any company. I sent all information needed to look me up and yet they can’t find my account, despite still charging. Going through my bank to cancel this out for good. At this point their company is just stealing.  I want to give this a 0 of 10 because of the hassle it takes to cancel, but I have to have a star to leave the review. If you plan on using this use a reloadable gift card. DO NOT ATTACHE YOUR BANK CARD to this company unless you plan on cancelling out the whole card.

reviews.title: Cobros no autorizados y mala experiencia
reviews.text:
Me suscribí a Unimeal por solo un mes, esperando que me ayudara con una rutina de alimentación personalizada. Lamentablemente, la app no fue útil para mí y no ofreció los resultados que prometía.

Lo peor es que, después me cobraron otro mes sin mi consentimiento. Solicité el reembolso inmediatamente sin haber iniciado ese nuevo mes y se negaron a devolver mi dinero, lo cual considero totalmente poco profesional.

Siento que esta práctica es un abuso y un robo, ya que no respetaron mi intención clara de cancelar y reembolso del servicio que no utilizaré. No recomiendo esta aplicación.
